descriptionInUI: Replaces vanilla ground AI on the front line with formation-keeping units that fight prolonged, scripted firefights, so the FLOT feels alive. Player CAS is the real source of attrition.

specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Longer, cinematic firefights. The front-line units are hidden from AI sensors, so AI CAS flights cannot find them; players are unaffected.
Tracers toward enemies the shooter cannot see.
